name: cc-dino
description: Pass the waiting time with a browser-style dinosaur game above the prompt, using jumps and ducks to avoid cacti and flying obstacles.
sourceDescription: The Chrome offline dinosaur, above the Claude Code prompt. Jump the cacti and duck the pterodactyls while Claude works. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.
author: manfye

category.label: Game Mods
category.basis: Provides games, pets or entertainment while working.
